notes:
dashy 0.6.0

Dashboard archetypes, end to end. A dashboard's character is now declared,
observed, and reconciled: a registry of five primaries and one modifier, a
nightly observation pass that appends candidates per project without ever
touching a declaration, a drift check wired into /diagnostics, and a
picklist on /settings/dashboards that turns an archetype into something a
person can set rather than hand-edited YAML.

Both writes into project repos are opt-in and default-off, per project:
  dashy observe-archetypes --enable-daily
  dashy enable-archetype-declaration <project-id>

The declaration key crashes any dashy older than this one at startup, so
the allowlist is per project rather than per install: a shared repo can
receive the key before the machine that reads it receives the code.

Also in this release: the queue-lane keyboard pass, the theme pipeline
batch, the transient-layer Esc convention, rollups and scheduler health on
/jobs, and a UI-polish batch.

Known and shipping unfixed: the Windows build bundles keyring without its
backends, so provider credentials fall back to dashy's own file store
rather than Credential Manager. Nothing is lost and the fallback is the
designed one.
